in_the_model: engines/laws.py (commutative, distributive, homomorphism templates witnessed over every op card); engines/funcalg.py (functions as annihilating operator polynomials in the shift E: gcd, lcm, cofactors)
name: servois_1814
statement: Named the distributive (f(x + y + ...) = f(x) + f(y) + ...) and commutative properties of functions and operators, and showed that linear operators that commute obey the laws of algebra, so identities proved for numbers carry to them: the calculus of operations, used as a proof method.
work: F.-J. Servois, Essai sur un nouveau mode d'exposition des principes du calcul différentiel (Annales de mathématiques pures et appliquées, vol. 5, 1814)
